appearances.title: Inkling 2 Mini now runs in LM Studio, MLX-VLM and Unsloth Desktop
appearances.summary: LM Studio added the 26B looped Apache 2.0 model (about 18GB to run), MLX-VLM added Mac support, and Unsloth says it fully works in its package and Desktop app with a 4-bit build running MCP tools and Blender, with an update that detects Dspark for roughly 2x faster decoding.
